title: Oral Pathology / oral Medicine I (DDS2107): Main Exam, Tue 14th July, 2026 11.00am
instructions: ATTEMPT ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO (2) IN SECTION B

items.text: The condition characterised by unilateral enlargement of one side of the face due to overgrowth of hard and soft tissues is called: (1 Mark)
A small mandible is referred to as: (1 Mark)
The congenital anomaly characterised by the absence of the clavicles and delayed closure of the fontanelles is: (1 Mark)
The visible yellow spots on the buccal mucosa near the commissures that represent ectopic sebaceous glands are called: (1 Mark)
